# How many employees does Obsidian Security have?

Obsidian Security, Inc. has approximately250 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Obsidian Security’s total headcount has grown65.7% from 151 employees in 2023 to 250 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Obsidian Security hiring right now?

Yes, Obsidian Security isactively hiring. Obsidian Security had96 active job postings in 2026, a 107.2% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/obsidian-security/employees#postings).

## About Obsidian Security’s Workforce

Obsidian Security, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company that employs **250** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 11th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/obsidian-security/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

Obsidian's workforce has grown **65.7%** from 2023 to 2026, and it is up **2.8%** year over year in 2026. The headcount is concentrated in North America ( **70.1%**), followed by Northern Europe ( **12.2%**) and Pacific Islands ( **7.1%**).

Obsidian's groups are Finance and Operations ( **41.4%**), Engineering ( **37.0%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **21.6%**), with Finance and Operations growing fastest (up **5.0%**). The average salary is **$173,627,** with regional medians of **$170,000** in North America and **$46,000** in South America, reflecting a **2.1%** year-over-year increase.

Obsidian's hiring activity surged in 2026, with active postings rising **107.2%** to **96** in the latest quarter. The company posted **96** openings in 2026, with hiring velocity increasing from **22** postings per month in 2023 to **31** per month in 2026. Employee sentiment is negative and broadly stable.
